evidence.behavior: Wan22FunControlToVideo uses ref_image[:1] and stores one reference latent.
WAN21.extra_conds takes reference_latents[-1], inherited by WAN22.

conclusion: Current shared-scene reference does not independently bind each actor identity; depth control constrains geometry, not exact facial/hand appearance.
guard: scripts/wan_reference_contract.py rejects multiple references rather than silently using only the last.

candidateResearch.name: Phantom
candidateResearch.scope: Single/multi-subject reference generation; different compatible weights required.

decision: Do not download or switch engines merely because a project claims identity preservation. Prioritize a bounded MultiAnimate compatibility audit (checkpoint size, architecture, attention/device paths) before deciding whether a Mac adapter is feasible. Keep current depth-only trial stop condition.
next: Validate matching quantized Wan2.1-I2V-14B base availability and architecture/attention path; retain bounded resource budgets. If viable, extract only selected tensors rather than downloading 34.24 GiB of duplicate base weights.
